name: ftlms-load-tests
description: k6 load testing for the FTLMS scheduler and campus-college-load flows, plus the Node scripts that seed/reset local test data.

scripts.loadtest:scheduler:rest: npm run mint-cookies && dotenv -e .env -- k6 run k6/scheduler.rest.js
scripts.loadtest:scheduler:rest:ramp: npm run ensure-results-dir && npm run clean-scheduler-ramp-output && npm run mint-cookies && dotenv -e .env -- k6 run --out json=results/scheduler-ramp.json k6/scheduler.rest.ramp.js
scripts.loadtest:scheduler:sessions:rest: npm run seed:schedule-race && npm run mint-cookies && dotenv -e .env -- k6 run k6/scheduler-sessions.rest.js
scripts.loadtest:scheduler:sessions:rest:ramp: npm run ensure-results-dir && npm run clean-scheduler-sessions-ramp-output && npm run seed:schedule-race-pool && npm run mint-cookies && dotenv -e .env -- k6 run --out json=results/scheduler-sessions-ramp.json k6/scheduler-sessions.rest.ramp.js
scripts.loadtest:ccl:rest: npm run reset && npm run seed:eval-batch && npm run mint-cookies && dotenv -e .env -- k6 run k6/campus-college-load.rest.js
scripts.loadtest:ccl:rest:ramp: npm run ensure-results-dir && npm run clean-ccl-ramp-output && npm run mint-cookies && dotenv -e .env -- k6 run --out json=results/ccl-ramp.json k6/campus-college-load.rest.ramp.js
